title: Reader registry submission, version 1
description: One team's structural readings of one subsystem over its own history, anonymised. Counts and shapes only. The corpus this builds is the treatment arm the existing longitudinal evidence lacks: codebases with real agent authorship and enough history to plot a curve.

project_key.description: An opaque key the submitter chooses and keeps, so a later submission can be recognised as the same subsystem without naming it. Never derived from the repository.

size_band.description: A band rather than a count, because an exact module count plus a language is close to identifying.

band.description: Deliberately coarse. Commit trailers undercount pasted output and overcount heavily rewritten drafts, so a percentage here would be false precision.

estimated_by.description: How the band was arrived at, in the submitter's words.

analyser.description: Carried through from the history dump. Two submissions are comparable only if these agree.

points.description: The history dump's points, with sha and any finer-grained date removed.

note.description: Anything the submitter wants recorded about the subsystem or the reading.
